comment: Shared expectations for record metadata inference.
gbdraw/core/record_metadata.py owns this inference for the Pyodide Worker and the renderer.
gbdraw/web/js/app/record-discovery.js reimplements it for the no-Worker upload fast path.
file, so the two implementations cannot drift apart unnoticed.
'replicon' is the value infer_record_source_metadata builds from the /chromosome or /plasmid
qualifier: a chromosome gains a 'Chromosome ' prefix, a plasmid keeps its qualifier verbatim.
Each subtitle case carries the raw /chromosome and /plasmid qualifiers for the JS fast path and the 'replicon' that infer_record_source_metadata derives from them for the Python helper.
